parent.prior_class: WSP87 DEV_SUBSTRATE_FEASIBLE; independent symbolic graph parity

purpose: Test a non-token grounded raw-utterance-to-action association using direct numerical weight edits from paid binary intervention feedback; synthetic templated English only, not general language understanding or knowledge.
hypothesis: Directly written hashed raw-character ngram to action weights generalize to withheld syntactic frames/nouns, support new verb aliases from a few grounded interventions, and retain old behavior without gradients.

stimulus.per_world: SHA256-seeded permutation maps 3 intents to 3 actuators, concealed from learners. Each training utterance is probed on all 3 actuators; each probe returns only binary consequence. Inputs do not reveal true class, template IDs, verb/intent taxonomy or permutation.
stimulus.stageA: 108 distinct utterances = 3 intents x 3 old verbs x 3 train templates x 4 train objects; 324 paid binary probes. Evaluate old verbs on heldout templates and objects, with no queries exposed before predictions freeze.
stimulus.stageB: 3 new verb aliases x 3 supported training-template/object contexts, each against all 3 actuators = 27 additional paid probes. No replay of old learner observations. Evaluate new aliases and preserve old holdout predictions.
stimulus.unknown: Evaluate unrelated unsupported commands for abstention.

learner: Raw Unicode character 3-5 gram feature hashing directly to fixed-width numeric class-association matrix. No word splitting, discrete lexical vocabulary, LM, next-token objective, gradients or external model. Set width, exact hash, normalization and abstention threshold before first DEV.
controls: Converged SGD softmax classifier trained on exact same features and observed paid intervention outcomes, fixed epochs/learning rate before DEV; report information/actions/parameters/compute, no artificial undertraining.
Independent exact-whole-utterance outcome lookup receiving same paid probes; no lexical parser.
Shuffled feedback negative using same feature machinery; shuffle independently and preserve class counts.
Zero numerical matrix and unrelated-command abstention.
interpretation: All checks PASS => DEV_GROUNDING_FEASIBLE only, NOT SCIENTIFIC_PASS; any miss => DEV_GROUNDING_NEGATIVE. Because all 3 actions are probed, feedback reveals class after paid trials; do not overstate causality or action efficiency. No claim of arbitrary-language transfer or factual knowledge.
sequence: Public fixture development only outside reserved seeds
Dual-platform exact-SHA WSP88 focused + inherited WSP80-87 + full root regression + pinned G29 atlas
After verified source qualification only, one frozen isolated DEV first-use by scoped owner
Publish all outcomes, including negatives, with source hash and costs
future: New separately preregistered experiments on untemplated natural utterances, unseen predicate induction, source-attributed real-world facts, conflict/correction, long-range memory, transfer and heldout QA with fully trained comparable controls.
